repo_model.summary: This repository is a RelBench generic-search candidate workspace with a baseline `main.py` that produces task-family-specific predictions. The Kapso evaluation suite runs the candidate in an isolated subprocess, validates and scores validation predictions, and archives full-fidelity results.

entrypoints.how_to_run: From the repository root, run `python main.py --debug` for the fast pipeline check or `python main.py` for the full run.

book.summary: This repository is a RelBench generic-search candidate workspace with a baseline `main.py` that produces task-family-specific predictions. The Kapso evaluation suite runs the candidate in an isolated subprocess, validates and scores validation predictions, and archives full-fidelity results.

toc.title: Architecture
toc.one_liner: RelBench task loading flows into candidate prediction generation, isolated grading, official validation scoring, and optional archival.

toc.title: Entrypoints
toc.one_liner: Run the candidate directly for debug/full modes, or invoke the supplied grader and prediction checker.

toc.title: Where to edit
toc.one_liner: Implement the candidate in `main.py` while using the starter helpers and preserving the immutable evaluation contract.

toc.title: Invariants
toc.one_liner: Prediction files, task-family formats, leakage boundaries, and validation scoring are strict contracts.

toc.title: Testing
toc.one_liner: Use debug mode, the prediction self-check, and the grader manifest for fast validation.

toc.title: Gotchas
toc.one_liner: Rolling snapshots, warning-only recommendation checks, empty-label MAP behavior, and the baseline fallback can surprise implementations.

toc.title: Dependencies
toc.one_liner: The runtime uses Python with NumPy and RelBench, configured through handler-provided environment variables and a sanitized local cache.
